At ET Wealth Expo, he explained why beaten-down stocks may never recover and urged investors to distinguish between asset allocation and stock selection, while cautioning against chasing strong past returns.

articles.title: Commerce ministry sets up committee for better utilisation of RELIEF initiative for exporters
articles.desc: The commerce ministry has established a six-member committee to enhance the RELIEF initiative for exporters. This initiative aims to mitigate challenges posed by rising freight costs and insurance premiums. The committee includes officials from various government departments working to improve fund utilization. It will assess the implementation of the initiative and recommend measures for better uptake. The overall goal is to support exporters during trade disruptions in crucial regions.

articles.title: Sebi pushes for resilient capital markets, focuses on investor protection: Chairman
articles.desc: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey emphasized the importance of accessible and efficient capital markets at a recent forum. He highlighted the growth in market capitalisation with significant annual fundraising through equity and debt. The number of investors in West Bengal has dramatically increased, indicating regional market participation. Additionally, various steps have been taken to streamline compliance and fundraising processes for issuers.

articles.title: Indian households shifting spending towards non-food items, services as consumption patterns evolve: Report
articles.desc: Indian household consumption is likely to become increasingly diversified, with spending gradually moving beyond food essentials towards non-food products and services, as changing dietary preferences and household structures reshape consumption patterns, according to an SBI Research report.

articles.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
articles.desc: Eight BSE 500 stocks gained in each of the five sessions between October 26 and 30, delivering cumulative returns of 10% to 21%.

articles.title: Karnataka sugarcane growers stage demo to press for their demands, district officials impose restrictions
articles.desc: Farmers in North Karnataka are intensifying their protest over the procurement price of sugarcane and other related issues. They staged blockades and sit-ins across several locations including Belagavi and Dharwad. The farmers are demanding a fair price of Rs 5,500 per tonne for sugarcane and other reforms. Local administrations have imposed prohibitory orders to prevent further protests on highways.

articles.title: ET Wealth Expo: Why market veteran S Naren thinks investors are getting gold, silver and asset allocation all wrong
articles.desc: ICICI Prudential MF's S Naren warns investors against chasing assets after spectacular rallies, highlighting how silver's 216% surge drew record ETF inflows before a 27% correction. At the ET Wealth Expo, he explained why genuine asset allocation means buying unpopular assets and why gold still deserves a place in portfolios.

articles.title: North Korean hackers linked to crypto thefts among world's best, experts say
articles.desc: Blockchain investigation firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attribute the heist to a North Korean hacking group known as "TraderTraitor," a name used in a 2022 joint warning from the FBI, CISA and US Treasury that described how hackers used malicious software and other tricks to target software developers and IT staff at cryptocurrency companies.

articles.title: F&O Talk: Big break above 23,200 can open doors for 23,500 for Nifty; Sudeep Shah picks 6 stocks ahead of Diwali
articles.desc: Nifty could extend its recovery towards 23,500 if it decisively breaks above the 23,150–23,200 resistance zone, says SBI Securities' Sudeep Shah. He also shares his outlook on IT, midcap and smallcap indices, sector trends and six stocks, including TVS Motor, Coforge and ICICI Bank, ahead of Diwali.

articles.title: Mistral AI publicly releases Large 4, targets cybersecurity users
articles.desc: Mistral said the released version was an upgrade from the one unveiled three weeks ago, following testing with governments and corporate users, which helped improve its performance.

articles.desc: Rising fatalities in Yemen’s conflict deepen the burden on families of fighters, both emotionally and financially.

articles.title: Why are US, Russia and China racing to put nuclear reactors on the moon?
articles.desc: Reactors could revolutionise moon exploration, providing energy for bases and mining, but risks of contamination remain.

articles.title: IPO ahead: Value-fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail gets Sebi nod to raise funds through public issue
articles.desc: Ratnadeep Retail has received Sebi approval to launch an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 400 crore and an offer for sale of 1.49 crore shares. The Hyderabad-based retailer plans to use part of the proceeds to repay borrowings and expand its store network across India.

articles.title: The Papers: 'Rush to recover stolen $6bn' and 'War on wind farms'
articles.desc: The theft of billions of dollars from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, makes Saturday's front pages.

articles.title: Mohammed Deif, rare footage and October 7 documents
articles.desc: Rare footage obtained by Al Jazeera offers a look at the life of former Hamas military commander, Mohammed Deif.

articles.title: Diwali stock picks: SBI Securities lists 11 stocks with up to 22% upside potential. Do you own any?
articles.desc: SBI Securities has picked 11 stocks for Samvat 2083, with up to 22% upside potential. The list spans steel, hospitality, jewellery, electronics and infrastructure.

articles.title: Oil prices soar 14% in October to 6-month high as US weighs fresh Iran strikes after midterms. More pain ahead?
articles.desc: Brent crude rose 13.6% in October to settle at a six-month high of $117.64 a barrel, as fears of fresh US strikes on Iran and threats to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz fuelled supply concerns. Analysts warn of further volatility, with Goldman Sachs flagging a possible rise to $120.

articles.title: 'Took stock of our bilateral cooperation': EAM Jaishankar meets US Secy of State Rubio on sidelines of G20
articles.desc: S Jaishankar held a bilateral meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Atlanta. The meeting focused on enhancing India-US cooperation and addressing geopolitical issues. Jaishankar emphasized that military solutions are not viable for resolving global challenges. Rubio also highlighted the importance of protecting economic and maritime security during the discussions. The G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting concluded with crucial dialogues on international economic stability.

articles.title: LIC Housing Fin Q2 net profit grows 12% YoY
articles.desc: LIC Housing Finance experienced a 12% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, reaching ₹1,507 crore. Total income for the quarter rose by 1.5% compared to the previous year. A notable improvement in asset quality contributed to the positive financial outcome and led to the reversal of impairment charges. Gross non-performing assets decreased significantly, highlighting better loan performance during the quarter.

articles.title: New India slips into red with 1,267 cr loss in Q2
articles.desc: New India Assurance Company has revealed a concerning net loss of ₹1,267 crore for the September quarter, sharply contrasting with last year's profit of ₹63 crore. The sharp downturn is attributed to underwriting losses in key segments such as property, motor, and health insurance. Despite this, gross written premiums showed a modest increase of 5.14% year-on-year, totaling ₹11,083 crore.

articles.title: Bank of Baroda's Q2 profit surges 36% YoY on NSE stake sale
articles.desc: In a remarkable financial performance, Bank of Baroda reported a staggering 36% rise in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹6,532 crore. This surge was propelled by significant non-interest income, recoveries from previously written-off accounts, and gains from the partial sale of its stake in the National Stock Exchange.

articles.title: Reliance Retail Q2 profit takes a hit on Qcomm push
articles.desc: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a significant drop in net profit, down 24.5% year-on-year to ₹2,619 crore in the last quarter. Despite this, revenue improved by 5.8% to ₹80,220 crore, largely driven by a surge in grocery sales. The company's profitability was affected by strategic investments and evolving festive season patterns, alongside rising finance costs stemming from increased borrowing and interest rates. Focus remains on improving transactions and business model adaptation.

articles.title: Jio Platforms profit zooms 14% on healthy user mix, digital play
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has unveiled an impressive 14% net profit growth to ₹8,387 crore for the September quarter, achieving a milestone subscriber count of 542 million, which includes 300 million utilizing 5G services. Revenue from operations climbed to ₹40,475 crore, fueled by a surge in digital services and a boost in average revenue per user, now at ₹218.8.

articles.title: Airtel Africa Q2 profit rises 16% to $254 million
articles.desc: Airtel Africa has revealed a remarkable 15.9% jump in its quarterly net profit, reaching $254 million, fueled by robust revenue growth. The total revenue escalated to $1.97 billion, showcasing a 25.7% rise in reported currency. Operating profit surged by 28.5% to $659 million, while customer numbers soared by 11.6%, pointing to the growing demand for data and mobile money services. The company achieved a record underlying Ebitda margin of 50.

articles.title: Indian Oil net profit triples YoY to 21,630 cr in Q2
articles.desc: Indian Oil experienced a remarkable surge in its net profit, which soared to ₹21,630 crore for the second quarter. This growth can be attributed to elevated pump prices and government subsidies for LPG sales. In contrast, the same quarter last year showcased a profit of only ₹7,610 crore. Moreover, operational revenue increased by 29%, reaching ₹2,62,935 crore, with the firm's operating profit from petroleum product sales more than doubling.

articles.title: GAIL Q2 profit surges over two fold YoY to 4,650 cr despite global disruptions
articles.desc: GAIL (India) has reported a remarkable increase in net profit, reaching ₹4,650 crore for the September quarter, more than double from the previous year. This growth is attributed to heightened gas marketing margins amid global energy supply disruptions. Revenue also surged by 31% to ₹45,924 crore. Furthermore, GAIL has moved forward with plans to list its subsidiary GAIL Gas, enhancing its stock value by 1.7% to ₹168 per share.

articles.title: Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
articles.desc: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

articles.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit takes a hit on exceptional items
articles.desc: Sun Pharmaceutical has seen a notable 36% drop in net profit, juxtaposed with an 11.8% rise in consolidated revenue. The uplift in revenue can be attributed largely to strong sales growth in India and emerging markets, particularly in domestic formulations. Conversely, US formulation sales faced a significant downturn. The company also marked progress in its integration planning for the acquisition of Organon, following the successful completion of regulatory approvals.

articles.title: Varun Beverages Q3 net profit rises 13% YoY, but margins fall
articles.desc: Varun Beverages recorded a substantial net profit increase of 13.5% for the quarter ending September 2026. Although there was strong revenue growth attributed to both local and international sales, the company's shares dropped because of shrinking operating margins. Challenges arose from heightened packaging costs and sugar price surges affecting gross margins. Additionally, Varun Beverages solidified its partnership with PepsiCo, extending their licensing agreement through 2049.

articles.title: Global Markets | European shares stumble at end of best month since June on AI worries
articles.desc: European stock markets slid as a global selloff in technology rattled investors, with the pan-European STOXX 600 index closing in negative territory. Concerns over soaring AI infrastructure costs loomed large. However, to add a silver lining, euro zone growth exceeded forecasts amid climbing inflation and borrowing costs, while firms such as Universal Music Group and Sanofi flaunted impressive earnings in these challenging times.

articles.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Midterm US elections, earnings, jobs data loom for AI-wary stock market
articles.desc: As we approach the US midterm elections next week, stock investors are bracing for the impact of significant corporate earnings reports. The market is already under pressure due to unsatisfactory AI earnings from leading firms, sparking worries about regulatory challenges. Investor focus will be on earnings from major players like Apple and AMD, with the upcoming jobs report additionally providing insights into the strength of the US economy.

articles.title: Tech rout drives gold to one-year low, white metals sink deep into oversold zone
articles.desc: Gold prices have plummeted to a year-long low, driven by anxiety over AI expenditure trends and declining tech shares. Other precious metals such as silver, platinum, and palladium have similarly seen their values drop sharply. Market experts forecast that precious metals may rebound, particularly if gold stays under $4,000. A decline in demand for silver's industrial and jewelry uses further complicates its market outlook, leaving a persistent downtrend expected.

articles.title: Alliant targets 1 GW of new data-center contracts in six months as power demand surges
articles.desc: Alliant Energy expects to sign contracts for about 1 gigawatt of additional data-center demand within six months, its finance chief said on Friday, as rising AI use and growing electrification push US power demand to record highs.

articles.title: Isro successfully launches NVS-03 satellite to bolster NavIC constellation
articles.desc: The rocket lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota at 11.51pm. After a flight of around 18 minutes and 40 seconds, the satellite was precisely injected into its designated elliptical orbit.

articles.title: Govt extends customs duty exemption on cotton imports till December 31
articles.desc: The Indian government has announced an extension of the customs duty exemption on cotton imports until December 31, 2026. This move aims to improve the availability of raw materials for the textile and apparel industry. The extension supports Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) while easing input cost pressures for manufacturers.

articles.title: Big Tech returns smallest share of cash to shareholders in 15 years, given AI spending
articles.desc: The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support for technology share prices. With companies buying back fewer shares, investors are increasingly dependent on heavy AI investments delivering enough profit growth to justify their valuations.

articles.title: October ends with a thud for Intel, Reddit, AI stalwarts
articles.desc: A fresh test of this year's technology rally sent the Nasdaq composite on Friday to its biggest decline since June. Chipmaker Intel and social media firm Reddit fell 29% and Sandisk, a chipmaker that has been one of the great beneficiaries of the AI capital-spending boom, dropped 13%.

articles.title: S&P Global revises outlook on Meta to negative on cashflow concerns
articles.desc: S&P Global Ratings on Friday revised its outlook on Meta Platforms to negative, citing significant uncertainty around capital spending and free operating cash flow.

articles.title: Trump's tariffs could shutter this Canadian town - its residents are fighting to save it
articles.desc: A century-old paper mill in Témiscaming, Quebec is indefinitely closed after the US imposed 50% tariffs on its products, putting hundreds out of work.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10 billion: FT
articles.desc: AI startup OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion and is now seeking to raise $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the Financial Times

articles.title: EAM Jaishankar slams sanctions, chokepoints disrupting global energy trade, holding prices hostage
articles.desc: S Jaishankar highlighted the challenges posed by disruptions in global oil supplies during the G20 meeting. He pointed out that the current energy crisis results from unpredictability and significant disruptions. Jaishankar emphasized the need for the G20 to ensure that energy markets remain open and predictable. He also mentioned India's efforts in critical minerals and the necessity for reliable energy supplies.

articles.title: India-Brazil bilateral trade set to reach $20 bn with focus on critical minerals, AI, defence: Envoy
articles.desc: Brazil's Ambassador to India highlighted growing trade relations, expecting bilateral trade to reach USD 20 billion soon. The partnership encompasses critical sectors such as defence, energy, and pharmaceuticals, promoting economic engagement. Both nations aim to deepen cultural ties, celebrating the centenary of musician Antonio Carlos Jobim in 2027. Recent political visits strengthened commitments toward technological and economic cooperation in multilateral forums.

articles.title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue
articles.desc: Countries have been trying to get a global agreement to halt nature decline back on track.

articles.title: Wall Street drops to its worst day since June after the sell-off for tech stocks deepens
articles.desc: Wall Street’s tech sell-off deepened on Friday as investors questioned whether massive spending on artificial intelligence will deliver enough returns to justify lofty valuations. The S&P 500 fell 1.8% and the Nasdaq 2.9%, with Intel plunging nearly 29% and Nvidia down 4.2%, while bitcoin also slid after a major hack at Binance.

articles.title: Oil-to-chemicals business powers Reliance Industries' record quarterly net profit, up 34% to ₹29,550 crore
articles.desc: Reliance Industries Ltd has set a new benchmark with a record net profit of ₹29,550 crore for the September quarter, fueled by significant advancements in the oil-to-chemicals and digital segments. With a yearly revenue surge of 28.5% to ₹3.38 lakh crore, the O2C division's Ebitda skyrocketed 68%, reflecting the advantages of elevated energy prices and the firm’s adaptability in challenging market scenarios.

articles.title: New-age beauty brands enjoy revenue glow-up
articles.desc: New-age beauty and personal care brands in India demonstrated impressive revenue growth in fiscal year 2026. Companies like Foxtale and Innovist achieved significant increases, doubling and tripling their sales figures. In contrast, older brands such as Sugar Cosmetics experienced revenue declines due to intensified competition and a lack of product innovation. Many newer brands focus on niche market segments and specific consumer problems to attract customers.

During his appearance on the Cheeky Pint podcast, where he also commented on AI's impact on math, Altman said: "A lot of people want […]

articles.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
articles.desc: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

articles.desc: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable. With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal […]

articles.title: US stocks today: Dow Jones crashes 500 pts, Nasdaq over 2.5% as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
articles.desc: US stocks tumbled on Friday as disappointing results from Intel and Amazon reignited concerns over rising artificial intelligence spending and uncertain returns. The Nasdaq recorded its biggest single-day percentage decline since June 5. Technology stocks led losses, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also ended October in negative territory.

articles.title: Nasdaq 100 cracks 5%, wipes out $2 trillion in October as AI spending fears deepen
articles.desc: Investor concerns about the high expenditures on artificial intelligence have intensified amidst rising borrowing costs. Major technology companies like Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft are increasing their capital outlays to strengthen AI infrastructure. The Nasdaq 100 index has already seen a significant decline of more than 5.8% in October. Analysts predict that global AI infrastructure spending could reach unprecedented levels by 2030.

articles.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth
articles.desc: Reddit shares plunged 23% after the company warned that Google's AI powered search features were hurting referral traffic and could lead to a decline in daily active users. Pinterest also fell after issuing a weaker revenue outlook, as pressure on European cross border sellers weighed on its business and growth expectations.

articles.desc: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. In a blog post on Friday, Google says it successfully booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku about being in space: Blue marble below Data streams in […]

articles.title: Fiscal deficit in H1 rises to 42.1% of FY27 target on higher capex, subsidies
articles.desc: By September 2026, the Centre's fiscal deficit had escalated to ₹7.14 lakh crore, exceeding last year's figures. This increase is fueled by a 10.7% rise in total expenditure, largely a result of heightened capital spending and food subsidies, while petroleum subsidies sharply declined. Gross tax revenue, however, saw a modest growth of 6.1%, even with lower excise duty collections attributed to tax reforms.

articles.title: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru
articles.desc: Starbucks could eventually show you a personalized digital menu when you pull up to the drive-thru. During an earnings call on Thursday, Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore "experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless," as spotted earlier by More […]

articles.title: Rivian’s autonomy gamble faces its first real test
articles.desc: During an hourlong earnings call last night, Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe spent less time talking about the production ramp of the all-important R2 SUV than he did hyping the company's still-unproven autonomous vehicle ambitions. But the company faces a crucial test later this year, when it rolls out its point-to-point hands-free driving feature - first […]

articles.title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
articles.desc: Intel shares plunged 30% after the chipmaker issued a weak fourth-quarter revenue forecast and warned of negative cash flow for the year. The warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks declining as weak PC demand and rising AI infrastructure costs weighed on sentiment.

articles.title: Vizio’s discounted Mini LED TV lets you skip the sign-ups and smarts
articles.desc: Modern smart TVs let you skip the streaming device, which is convenient, but they also come with their own issues, including privacy concerns and frequent updates. The Vizio Mini LED Quantum TV lets you cut out the rigamarole and just get straight to the HDMI ports. And right now, it’s discounted at Walmart, with the […]

articles.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
articles.desc: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.

articles.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
articles.desc: Syrma SGS Technology reported an 87.2% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 73.2%, reaching a record high of Rs 1,999.5 crore. The company’s exports grew by 91% year-on-year, showcasing strong international demand. Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.

articles.title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
articles.desc: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.

articles.title: Niti Aayog's Lahiri flags growth risks in case of further monetary policy tightening
articles.desc: In India, it's essential for policymakers to harmonize growth output with inflation expectations. Niti Aayog’s Ashok Lahiri pointed out the importance of addressing inflation alongside job creation. He urged banks to play a pivotal role in linking enterprises with financial support and investment options. To capitalize on its natural resources, West Bengal must focus on industry attraction, while effective land acquisition and good infrastructure remain key for business development.

articles.title: Spandana Sphoorty makes profit in Q2 against a loss year-ago
articles.desc: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore year-ago loss. Assets under management grew 31% to Rs 5,364 crore, while improving asset quality reduced gross and net NPAs.

articles.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
articles.desc: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

articles.title: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
articles.desc: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

articles.title: Democratic senator blames Egypt press crackdown on US military aid decision
articles.desc: Chris Murphy said waiving a human rights condition on aid paved the way for arrests of journalists.

articles.title: RBI deliberates economic risks at 625th Central Board meeting chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India conducted its 625th Central Board meeting under Governor Sanjay Malhotra. The board reviewed economic conditions and potential risks facing India’s economy while evaluating the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation’s activities. Additionally, the board members participated in the Integrity Pledge as part of Vigilance Week 2026. Deputy Governors and other board members contributed to the discussions during the meeting.

articles.title: India's services trade surplus rises to $53.39 billion in Q2
articles.desc: The country received $113.029 billion under this head during the three months while it paid $59.637 billion, the data showed. September saw the biggest surplus at $19.208 billion while it was $17.647 billion and $16.537 billion in July and August respectively.

articles.title: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: Revenue up 6%, but late festive season, digital spends hit profit
articles.desc: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: The company's gross revenue increased 6.4% YoY to Rs 91,716 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 86,169 crore in the year-ago period. The growth came despite the absence of major festive occasions during the quarter, with the festive calendar shifting to the December quarter.

articles.title: Reliance Industries announces fundraising, to raise Rs 15,000 crore through NCDs
articles.desc: Reliance Industries has approved plans to raise up to Rs 15,000 crore through non-convertible debentures via private placement. The fundraising announcement came with the company's Q2 earnings where it reported a 41% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore.

articles.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
articles.desc: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) on Friday reported a 41% year-on-year (YoY) growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 18,165 crore in the corresponding period last year.

articles.title: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
articles.desc: Jio Q2 Results: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 8,389 crore in Q2 FY27, its first results after listing. Revenue grew 11% to Rs 40,475 crore, supported by subscriber additions, growth in digital services and a marginal increase in ARPU.

articles.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq sinks 2.2% as Amazon, Intel fuel fresh fears over AI spending
articles.desc: Wall Street experienced significant losses as the Nasdaq fell to its lowest level in nearly three months. Concerns about rising capital expenditures at Amazon and cash burn warnings from Intel influenced the technology sector's downturn. Major technology stocks like Alphabet and Nvidia also saw notable declines due to investor scrutiny. Defensive sectors like consumer staples and healthcare gained some traction in response to the selloff.

articles.title: PB Fintech, Delhivery improve Q2 profits; Binance's $6.3 billion caper
articles.desc: PB Fintech on Friday reported a strong jump in profit and revenue for the July-September quarter. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

articles.title: India’s FTAs to open access to $85 trillion market; Piyush Goyal urges exporters to go global
articles.desc: India's trade agreements are expected to provide exporters preferential access to markets with a combined GDP of $85 trillion, covering 76% of the global economy, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said. He urged businesses to expand internationally, improve product quality and build global brands as India pursues additional trade pacts.

articles.title: NTPC Green Energy Q2 Results: Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 137 crore, revenue rises 53%
articles.desc: NTPC Green Energy reported a 56.2% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 137.5 crore, driven by 53.2% revenue growth. EBITDA margins improved, while new solar capacity boosted its operational renewable energy portfolio.

articles.title: CBIC holds outreach programme in Chandigarh to discuss GST 2.0 reforms with taxpayers
articles.desc: More than 200 taxpayers and industry representatives participated in an outreach programme with CBIC leadership. The engagement aimed to discuss implementation of reforms from the 57th GST Council meeting. Key reforms include a higher threshold for criminal prosecution and improved processes for tax refunds and registration. This initiative underscores the Finance Ministry's commitment to transparency and stakeholder engagement. The implemented reforms are set to take effect from April 1, 2027.

articles.title: Big dividends, bigger losses? The hidden risk in Wall Street's highest-yielding stocks
articles.desc: Several US stocks offer dividend yields exceeding 10%, led by mortgage REITs Annaly Capital Management and AGNC Investment above 16%. However, significant share-price declines highlight risks surrounding dividend sustainability, payout ratios, debt and overall investment returns.

articles.title: India PE/VC investments jump 45% to $7 billion in September, highest in over two years
articles.desc: Private equity and venture capital investments in India saw significant growth in September 2026. The total investment reached USD 7 billion, marking a substantial increase from August. Large-value deals accounted for 76% of the total investments during the July-September quarter. Despite this growth, the number of deals declined compared to last year. Investors are expected to remain cautious amid economic challenges and inflation pressures.

articles.title: India bonds buckle for fourth straight month on oil's climb
articles.desc: Indian government bonds ended October with losses, marking a fourth consecutive decline in bond yields. Brent crude oil prices surged, raising inflation concerns for the country. The Reserve Bank of India raised its policy rate for the first time in nearly four years this month. Foreign investments in Indian bonds fell to a four-month low, causing further concerns about the rupee's performance.

articles.title: US Stock Market Highlights: Dow Jones crashes 500 pts, Nasdaq over 2.5% as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
Google value plunges by $500bn as its own AI search hits ad sales
articles.desc: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI own search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

articles.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9%
articles.desc: Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27. Net interest income grew 9% to Rs 13,026 crore, while asset quality improved, with the gross NPA ratio declining to 1.78%. Global advances and deposits also recorded double-digit growth.

articles.title: India’s forex reserves fall $1.2 billion to $719.74 billion as of October 24
articles.desc: India’s foreign exchange reserves fell by $1.2 billion to $719.74 billion in the week ended October 24, according to the RBI. The decline followed a sharper $5 billion drop in the previous week, when reserves stood at $721.02 billion, indicating continued pressure on the country's foreign exchange kitty.

articles.title: ICAI to issue guidance note on new audit reporting framework for multi-state cooperative societies
articles.desc: ICAI is set to release a guidance note on the new audit reporting framework for multi-state cooperative societies. The cooperation ministry published the Multi-State Co-operative Societies (Auditor's Report) Order, 2026, on October 14. This initiative aims to enhance financial oversight and risk detection in the cooperative sector. Auditors will need to follow a structured approach in reporting various compliance parameters.

articles.title: Coforge among 6 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 20% in a month
articles.desc: Six BSE 200 stocks, including Coforge, Indian Hotels and Kotak Mahindra Bank, hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex rallied, with monthly gains reaching 17%.
